prose:
The readable opening of a New York Times report describes visual-effects workers experimenting with AI-assisted rotoscoping, the frame-by-frame isolation of objects or people from a shot. Interviewees see possible time savings on tedious work but stress that the tools remain imperfect.

The rest of the article was blocked by an access check. This partial account does not establish precise savings, complete automation or the eventual employment impact, and the feed’s cost figure was not independently validated from the retrieved passage.
highlights: Only the article opening was readable
Employment effects remain an open question
